topic: A destructive TRUNCATE in a gated warehouse test must be guarded to loopback-only hosts
lesson: The reconciliation D-0008 gated leaf TRUNCATEs ingest_batch + sap_transaction CASCADE on whatever DB WAREHOUSE_PG_* points at. Guard it: BEFORE truncating, assert the warehouse host (WAREHOUSE_PG_HOST) is loopback/local (127.0.0.1, ::1, or localhost) and THROW a clear error refusing to run against a non-local warehouse — so a misconfigured WAREHOUSE_PG_* can never wipe a shared/production warehouse. Also fix the P2: tools/quality-gate.test.mjs wrapping the declared test lists in new Set removes the gate's exactly-one-suite detection (a file registered in two suites is silently deduped) — compare with duplicate detection preserved (e.g. detect duplicates before dedup, or assert no file appears in more than one suite) instead of Set-then-compare.
